line: Nine of Disks: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and ruler, as the chapter gives them (pdf 181, 236).

quotes.quote: The Nine of Disks is called Gain.
The card is ruled by Venus in Virgo.
These cards are attributed to Yesod.

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: His description of the card, not a divinatory reading.

quotes.quote: It shows good luck attending material affairs, favour and popularity.
